description:
While executing JMAP-zx3s.1 (workspace policy: pick Other vs Unknown), I confirmed all type crates use `Other(String)` (mailbox.rs, query.rs, submission.rs, calendars/tasks notification.rs, etc.). But `crate-jmap-chat-client/src/types.rs` manually rolls two enums — `ChatMemberRole` (lines 124-131) and `BodyType` (lines 178-188) — that use `Unknown(String)` instead.

These don't use the workspace `impl_string_enum!` macro from jmap-types; they have hand-rolled Serialize/Deserialize impls. The variant naming divergence is:
- Wire format: unaffected (the variant tag is Rust-side, not on the wire).
- Source consistency: divergent — every type-crate enum says `Other(String)`, these client-side enums say `Unknown(String)`.
- Tests: existing tests in `crate-jmap-chat-client/tests/{message_smoke_tests.rs, chat_smoke_tests.rs}` use `BodyType::Unknown(s)` and reference workspace 'Unknown(String) policy' verbiage that is now stale.

**Question whether these should even live in jmap-chat-client at all.** Result enums normally belong in the canonical type crate (jmap-chat-types), not the client crate. Possible split bead: move ChatMemberRole and BodyType to jmap-chat-types, then unify under the workspace impl_string_enum! macro.

**Scope options:**
- (A) Minimal rename: `Unknown(String)` → `Other(String)` in jmap-chat-client + update referring tests + doc strings. ~10-line public API break (variant name change), tests updated in same commit.
- (B) Move to jmap-chat-types and use impl_string_enum!. Larger refactor, sets up the canonical-template path. Public API break for jmap-chat-client consumers in both shape and import path.

Pre-existing finding: this bead was discovered while ratifying JMAP-zx3s.1's recommendation (option A: doc edit only). The premise that doc-edit was zero-churn turned out to be false workspace-wide; this bead captures the residue.
title: jmap-chat-client: ChatMemberRole and BodyType use Unknown(String) — diverges from workspace Other(String) pattern
